issues.description: Exercise 1 template uses an inconsistent attribute name for the query register: it assigns the register to `self._query_register` but then constructs the circuit with `self.query_register`, which is not defined. This will raise an `AttributeError` in `__init__` before students can work on the exercise and conflicts with the solution, which consistently uses `self.query_register`.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template `__init__`, rename `self._query_register` to `self.query_register` (or change circuit construction to use `self._query_register`). Prefer matching the solution: define `self.query_register = QuantumRegister(...)` and build `QuantumCircuit(self.query_register)`.
